Welcome to Modern Powers!

 

We are excited to announce that picks are ready to be made for our upcoming season of ModernPowers! This is your chance to decide what country you would like to represent and develop over our second season! You are free to choose any country want and try your best to make it the best version of itself that has ever existed!

The claim form to pick your country is right here, so do your research, submit your claim, and join us!

We are now implementing a new tier system to our game. This ranks countries from most influential and most time-consuming to countries that you don't really need a lot of background on to start playing. A brief description of each tier can be found here and a list of each country and their tier level can be found here! If you have never played ModernPowers and are interested in joining us, you can always read up on our rules and head over to our IRC channel where we'll always have a mod or two on who can answer any questions you may have about the game - or if you just want to talk!

Another thing that will be new for this upcoming season will be that as you make posts with your countries, you will need to add it to your wiki. This is to make everything a lot easier for players who end up joining midway through a season to catch up! You also are not allowed to declaim if you are in the middle of a conflict. You will need to finish the conflict or war or you'll run the risk of a permaban. This is because last year we had multiple claimants do so, which put a lot more work on the mods than we had time for.

Anything else, just simply ask. If you put in a priority claim, we'll be PM'ing you just to remind you to submit the claim to the claim form.

 

How you'll know if your claim has been approved:

 

You'll receive a PM from a mod to join our IRC channel so we can talk through any discrepancies or questions that you may have. Once that is done, get your posts ready for our April 12th start date!

 

Puzzled or intrigued? Do contact the mods or join our IRC and we will be glad to answer your questions

Hope to see you all soon,
